llms.body:
# Setmore
 
> Setmore is free online appointment scheduling and booking software for service-based businesses. The Free plan covers up to 4 users and unlimited appointments per month at $0. Pro is $5 per user/month (annual) or $12 per user/month (monthly) for unlimited users and appointments. Accept payments through Square, Stripe, PayPal, or LawPay. Available worldwide on web, iOS, Android, and desktop, with 24/7 human support on every plan, including Free.
 
Setmore is a full booking platform for service businesses — scheduling, payments, team management, and a branded Booking Page in one place. A few things worth getting right, because they're often misquoted:
 
- The Free plan is genuinely free with no time limit. It is not a trial.
- Pricing is per user. There are only two published plans, Free and Pro. There is no "Premium" or "Team" tier; larger organizations use custom Enterprise plans.
- Live Receptionist is a paid add-on (US only) and has real people answer your calls 24/7.
- Setmore is not a meeting-only scheduler, and not a marketplace. Your customers, Booking Page, and payments are your own.
 
For a full, structured overview written for AI assistants, see the LLM info page first.
 
## Start here
- [About Setmore for AI assistants](https://www.setmore.com/llm-info): Structured overview of what Setmore is, who it's for, features, pricing, integrations, and model-ready answers.
- [Setmore homepage](https://www.setmore.com): Product overview and free sign-up.
- [Pricing](https://www.setmore.com/pricing): Free and Pro plans, the Live Receptionist add-on, and Enterprise, with a full feature comparison.
- [Our mission](https://www.setmore.com/our-mission): Why Setmore exists — helping service businesses connect with their customers.
- [FAQs](https://www.setmore.com/faqs): Common questions about plans, payments, setup, and support.
 
## Product features
- [All features](https://www.setmore.com/features): The full feature set across booking, payments, reminders, staff, and calendar sync.
- [Booking Page](https://www.setmore.com/features/booking-page): A branded page where customers self-book 24/7; works as a standalone site.
- [Online scheduling](https://www.setmore.com/online-scheduling): 24/7 self-booking through your Booking Page.
- [Calendar and appointments](https://www.setmore.com/features/appointments): One calendar for your whole team, with a real-time view of the day.
- [Team scheduling](https://www.setmore.com/features/staff-scheduling): Team profiles, individual calendars and Booking Pages, and permission levels.
- [Class booking](https://www.setmore.com/features/class-booking): Group sessions and classes with multiple attendees.
- [Payments](https://www.setmore.com/features/payments): Take payment online or in person with Square, Stripe, or PayPal — no cut taken by Setmore.
- [Website widgets](https://www.setmore.com/features/website-widgets): Add a 'Book Now' button or embed your Booking Page on your site.
- [QR code booking](https://www.setmore.com/features/qr-code-appointment-booking): A free QR code that opens your Booking Page in one scan.
- [Desktop app](https://www.setmore.com/features/desktop-app): Free scheduling app for Windows and Mac.
- [Multiple locations](https://www.setmore.com/features/multiple-locations): Manage several branches under one login (Pro, currently in early release — contact support to enable; not available for HIPAA accounts).
 
## Integrations and payments
- [All integrations](https://www.setmore.com/integrations): 40+ integrations across payments, calendars, video, websites, marketing, and CRM, plus thousands more through Zapier.
- [Reserve with Google](https://www.setmore.com/integrations/reserve-with-google): Take bookings straight from Google Search and Maps through your Business Profile. Available on Free and Pro.
- [Mailchimp](https://www.setmore.com/integrations/mailchimp): Automatically add new customer details to a Mailchimp list for email marketing.
- [Payments](https://www.setmore.com/features/payments): Connect Square, Stripe, PayPal, or LawPay on any plan, including Free — Setmore takes no cut.
- Calendar sync: Google Calendar and Office 365, with 1-way and 2-way sync.
- Video meetings: Zoom and Google Meet, with links added to bookings automatically.
- Social booking: a 'Book Now' button for Facebook and Instagram.
 
## Add-ons and larger teams
- [Live Receptionist](https://www.setmore.com/live-receptionist): Real people answer your calls 24/7 in your brand voice, book appointments into your calendar, and route calls, in English or Spanish. Paid add-on, US only.
- [Enterprise](https://www.setmore.com/enterprise): Custom plans, tailored integrations, pricing, and a dedicated account manager for larger organizations.
 
## Support
- [24/7 human support](https://www.setmore.com/human-support): Real people by chat, email, or phone, any hour, on every plan.
- [Support center](https://support.setmore.com/en): Step-by-step help articles and setup guides.
 
## Industries
- [All industries](https://www.setmore.com/industries): Setmore's use cases across beauty, wellbeing, healthcare, professional services, education, creative, and trade.
- [Hair salons](https://www.setmore.com/industries/salon): Scheduling for salons, with staff calendars and deposits to cut no-shows.
- [Barber shops](https://www.setmore.com/industries/barber-shops): Online booking built for barbers and their teams.
- [Nail salons](https://www.setmore.com/industries/nail-salon): Let clients book manicures and treatments 24/7.
- [Spas](https://www.setmore.com/industries/spa): Booking for spas and wellness treatments, with deposits and packages.
- [Gyms](https://www.setmore.com/industries/gym): Class and session booking for gyms and studios.
- [Personal trainers](https://www.setmore.com/industries/personal-trainer): 1-on-1 sessions, recurring bookings, and video training.
- [Yoga studios](https://www.setmore.com/industries/yoga): Group class scheduling with attendee limits.
- [Doctors and medical](https://www.setmore.com/industries/doctors): HIPAA-ready scheduling with Setmore Health.
- [Dentists](https://www.setmore.com/industries/dentist): Patient booking and reminders to reduce no-shows.
- [Legal](https://www.setmore.com/industries/legal): Consultation booking with secure LawPay payments.
- [Photographers](https://www.setmore.com/industries/photography): Session booking and deposits for shoots.
- [Home and trade services](https://www.setmore.com/industries/home-repair): Scheduling for on-site and trade work.
- [Interview scheduling](https://www.setmore.com/industries/interview-scheduling): Booking for hiring and recruitment teams.
 
## Optional
- [Blog](https://www.setmore.com/blog): Guides, tips, and product updates for service-based businesses.
- [Guides](https://www.setmore.com/guides): In-depth resources for growing a service business.

FAQs

  • A Booking Page showcases your service menu, availability, and prices online. It has a custom URL and can function as a standalone website. Visitors can self-schedule and pay for appointments 24/7 without having to call, email, or travel to your premises.

    Sign up for your free appointment scheduler and create a Booking Page in minutes.

  • Your calendar is only visible to you and permitted staff members. Add appointments, edit your working hours, and get a real-time view of team schedules. When you update your availability, it reflects on your Booking Page.

    Your Booking Page is accessible by anyone. It can function as a free booking website or connect to your existing website. Share its link directly, through emails and DMs, and connect it to your social media pages. Customers can schedule appointments online when it suits them. Once a booking is confirmed, the details land in your calendar.

    Your calendar and Booking Page work in harmony, syncing instantly.

  • Simply enable a payment integration and opt to accept Booking Page payments in your app’s settings. Learn more about accepting payments online and in-person with your free appointment booking app.

  • Yes, 1-way and 2-way sync options are available to connect other calendars. 2-way syncs are particularly popular as they send appointment details to and from Setmore.

    Learn more about reducing scheduling conflicts with Google and Office 365 calendar syncs.

  • Free appointment software offers new leads and loyal customers an instant route to book online. There’s no need to contact you directly to find a time that works.

    Your Booking Page connects to your existing website, Facebook, and Instagram, enabling people to learn about your services and self-schedule appointments 24/7. Every online channel becomes an all-new conversion machine. You can also add your Booking Page URL and QR code to emails, business cards, and promo items, helping to capitalize on interest without any wait times.

  • Every Setmore account comes with an online Booking Page and all-in-one calendar. You can create unlimited appointments, automate confirmations and reminders, add staff, host video meetings, and store customer details.

    Explore our plans to learn the differences between Setmore Free and Pro.
